projects.name: Metrics & Major Shareholding project
details: Metrics & Major Shareholding project
• Developed an automated solution using UiPath to perform Independent Shareholding Confirmation (ISC)
validation directly from multiple data sources, enhancing accuracy and timeliness of regulatory reporting.
• Created standardized and scalable metric templates to capture data volumes, trends, and exception
patterns, improving management information reporting and decision support.
• Built a custom Excel macro to log, track, and audit the number of activities, disclosures, and submissions
processed on any given date, strengthening transparency and governance.
